correctness.rationale: For each word w(i,j), deletion of a one leaves exactly one weight-1 output if adjacent, two otherwise; hence ℓ+2e≤n-1. Two adjacent double-one words have a common weight-2 output after deleting their distinct exterior zeros, so ℓ≤ceil((n-1)/2). Combining gives |C|≤n-1-floor((n+1)/4). The stated U_r=(2r,2r+1) and V_s=(4s+1,4s+4) achieve equality; their remaining-one locations are disjoint and their zero-deletion shadows have disjoint adjacent/nonadjacent gap classes and distinct first-one bands, including n=2 boundary. Independent brute-force compatibility search computed exact maxima n=2..7 and verified construction; no finite test substitutes for the all-length shadow argument.
